senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. טמם) [to be filled up, inaccesible,] to be unclean; v. טָמֵא II.

units: <cite ref="Yoma 39a:3">Yoma 39ᵃ</cite> <he>אדם מְטַמֵּא עצמו מעט מְטַמְּאִין וכ׳</he> if a man begins to defile himself a little (through sin), he will soon be defiled largely.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 3:5">Yad. III, 5</cite>, a. fr. <he>מט׳ את הידים</he> their handling makes the hands unclean (washing the hands is required after handling them).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 1:1">Kel. I, 1</cite>; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 1:11">Eduy. I, 11</cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 6:2">Makhsh. VI, 2</cite> <he>טִימְּאוּ</he>; Y. Dem. V, 24ᵈ <he>טִימּוּ</he>.

senses.gloss: to become unclean, to be made unclean.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:1">Ukts. I, 1</cite> <he>מְטַמֵּא ומִיטַּמֵּא</he> eventually makes unclean and becomes unclean.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:1">Kel. II, 1</cite> <he>מִיתְטַמְּאִין וכ׳</he> (ed. Dehr. <cite ref="M00994"><he>מִיטַּ׳</he></cite>) are fit to become unclean and to make unclean.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ומיט׳ מאחוריהן ואינן מיט׳ וכ׳</he> Mish. ed. (Talm. ed. <he>מִטַּ׳</he>) may be made unclean through their backs (touching uncleanness), &c. Ib. VI, 4 <he>ונִטְמְאוּ</he> and which became unclean; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Yoma 38b">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>בא לִטַּמֵּא פְּתָחִין לו</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) to him who is willing to defile himself, doors are open; <cite ref="Shabbat 104a:10">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 55a">Ab. Zar. 55ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 29b">Men. 29ᵇ</cite>

senses.gloss: to make one’s self unclean by handling a corpse &c. (v.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 60a:11">Yeb. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>מִטַּמֵּא לה</he> he (the priest) may attend to her burial; a. fr.
